policy: SEO symbol map & to and, $ to usd, % to pct
bug_report: slugify is mangling product titles that contain symbols. 'R&D' slugifies to 'r-d' — the '&' is dropped entirely, which changed the search term and tanked the page's ranking. Symbols in titles (&, $, %) need to be preserved as the team's standard words in the slug, not stripped. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py. Fix boltons.strutils.slugify without breaking its existing behaviour.
non_guessable: the project policy was added in a documented commit then removed by a misleading 'refactor' regression; HEAD is stock boltons — git log/blame reveals the rule
decision_subject: feat: expand &/$/% to the team's SEO analytics words in slugify
decision_rationale: Product-page slugs must preserve the symbols &, $, % as the analytics-standard words: & -> 'and', $ -> 'usd', % -> 'pct' (NOT 'dollar'/'percent' — those broke search-tag matching). Applied before the existing punct split so 'R&D' -> 'r-and-d', '$5 sale' -> 'usd-5-sale', '50% off' -> '50-pct-off'.
